summary: Flathead NF lookout in Flathead County, MT; L-4 cab dated 1937 by one listing, standing in 1940 survey, destroyed in the 1950s; listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in the 1950s per firelookout.com; Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as gone

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey description of the Forest Service lookout house
Listed as destroyed in the 1950s; 1950 stands in for the decade and is not a date from the source

evidence.supports: about eight miles north of the Spotted Bear Ranger Station

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says 8 miles north; the 1940 survey text says 8 miles north-northwest. Both are reported in the story; the sources are not reconciled.

notes_for_editor: Build year 1937 and destruction in the 1950s rest on firelookout.com; the 1940 survey text independently shows a lookout house in place. Only the destruction decade is given, so the 1950 event year is a placeholder for the decade. Brief's status 'gone' and county match. No corrections proposed. Nothing found on staffing, on what remains at the site, or on public access; the access field is left out.
